question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Chaotic
solution:
The correct answer is: **Systematic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Chaotic"** refers to a state of complete disorder and confusion. (अराजकता)

 
 
• **Example:** The city streets were chaotic after the sudden downpour caused flooding everywhere.
 
 
 
• **"Systematic"** refers to something done or acting according to a fixed plan or system; it implies organization and order. (व्यवस्थित)
 
 
• **Example:** The company has a systematic approach to training its employees for better productivity.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **"Chaotic"** is **"Systematic"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Systematic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Confused** (भ्रमित): Lacking clarity or understanding; disorganized or unclear.

 
 
• **Example:** She was confused about which route to take after the GPS signal went out.
 
 
 
• **Dressed** (सज्जित): Wearing clothes or prepared in a particular way.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were dressed neatly for the school play.
 
 
 
• **Obscure** (अस्पष्ट): Not discovered or known about; uncertain or hard to understand.
 
 
• **Example:** The meaning of the ancient text remains obscure to modern scholars.
